edits.exact_before: It is God upon the throne whom we trust.
edits.proposed_after: It is God upon his throne whom we trust.
edits.rationale: Live Spurgeon witness has the pronoun his in the original English closing sentence; this fixes source-anchor transcription, not the approved text.

edits.exact_before: что единственное наше спасение — в призывании имени Его.
edits.proposed_after: что наша единственная защита — в призывании Его имени.
edits.rationale: Calvin's original English has our only safety, not salvation. Keep the doctrine from being silently strengthened by the translator.

edits.exact_before: Попробую, однако, набросать образ святости, чтобы мы ясно видели его пред мысленными очами. (а)
edits.proposed_after: Попробую, однако, набросать образ святости, чтобы мы ясно видели его пред мысленными очами. Однако не следует забывать: даже всё, что я скажу, будет в лучшем случае лишь бедным и несовершенным наброском. (а)
edits.rationale: Adds the omitted Ryle disclaimer ('my account is but a poor imperfect outline') between consecutive clauses; the old selection claimed no omissions.

edits.exact_before: they look like hypocrites, though they are not so.
edits.proposed_after: Oh that my head were waters, and mine eyes fountains of tears, that I might weep abundantly over them all!
edits.rationale: Original Flavel passage continues directly with the lament translated at the end of the current Russian body, which falls outside the old source end-anchor.

edits.exact_before: goes on year after year, attending on the means of grace, but then, like Pharaoh's lean kine, he is never the better, but rather the worse for them.
edits.proposed_after: he is never the better, but rather the worse for them.
edits.rationale: CCEL inserts an inline [cow?] editor note after lean kine that prevents a literal uninterrupted anchor match. The shorter closing clause is directly present in the source.
